findings.title: Testimonial card quotes rely on 'Coming soon' placeholders
findings.reference: Reference testimonial cards carry real client names, roles and quotable endorsement copy under the star row
findings.candidate: Both testimonial cards show generic 'Coming soon' placeholder copy under the star row and a placeholder avatar, weakening the social-proof register of the cinematic band
findings.direction: Populate each testimonial card with fictionalized-but-realistic client name, role and 2–3 sentence endorsement text consistent with Business Facts (Kenya SMEs, service firms, ecommerce, hospitality, travel, B2B); replace the placeholder avatar circle with a styled initial avatar, keeping the white card, purple stars and trailing quote-glyph tile anatomy unchanged

findings.title: Newsletter band lacks the illustrated photo/illustration mass
findings.reference: Reference newsletter band pairs the sign-up copy with a visible illustration motif (bell/paper-plane style graphics) giving the band visual mass and character
findings.candidate: Candidate newsletter band is mostly typographic with only a small bell icon; the band feels lighter and flatter than the reference's illustrated treatment
findings.direction: Enlarge and position the flat notification-bell/paper-plane illustration (purple line style, allowed flat motif) beside the H3 on the left column, sized ~120–160px, so the band's left column carries comparable visual mass to the reference while keeping the right-side form card unchanged

findings.title: Hero panel width slightly narrow relative to photo mass
findings.reference: Reference hero panel occupies roughly 40% width with generous internal padding and the photo wash filling the full band
findings.candidate: Candidate hero panel is present and correctly styled but reads slightly narrower with tighter internal padding, leaving more photo expanse on the right than the reference silhouette
findings.direction: Widen the hero dark inset panel to ~40vw at desktop (max ~560px) and increase internal padding to 40px so paragraph measure sits near 46ch; keep the rounded 20px panel radius, eyebrow chip, two-weight H1 stack and capsule CTA as-is

findings.title: Services wide-card stat strip emphasis slightly subdued
findings.reference: Reference's wide service card features a prominent horizontal stat/label strip (Product / Intent / Store) with bold dark labels as a distinct right-side zone
findings.candidate: Candidate wide card includes the stat strip but the labels render smaller and less visually separated, reading as inline text rather than a distinct horizontal band
findings.direction: Give the wide card's right-side strip its own zone: three columns with bold 20–22px dark labels above 12px muted captions, separated by 1px #E3DAF5 vertical hairlines, vertically centered against the card body and clear of the Learn More capsule

findings.title: Contact band info-tile hairline treatment
findings.reference: Reference contact band shows three feature tiles sitting below a clear full-width hairline separator above them
findings.candidate: Candidate contact band renders the three tiles but the hairline separator above the row is fainter/less continuous than the reference
findings.direction: Add a full-container-width 1px rgba(255,255,255,.12) top border on the info-tile row inside the dark contact band, with 24px top padding before the tiles, matching the reference's pre-tile separator

visual.summary: The candidate is a very strong realization of the blueprint and the reference's design DNA: the duotone dark hero with left inset panel, alternating pale-lavender/white/photographic band rhythm, eyebrow-chip + two-weight H2 system, capsule CTA language with trailing arrow circles, pale-lavender icon-tile service cards in 4/2-wide/4 arrangement, indigo collapsed accordion bars with one expanded white card, dark cinematic testimonial band with white cards, newsletter form, centered dark contact band and four-column footer with chevron link lists are all present and faithful. Typography scale, spacing cadence, surface rhythm and image duotone treatment match closely on both desktop and mobile, where the drawer nav, stacked hero and snap testimonial row behave correctly. The remaining gaps are content-finishing level: testimonial cards still carry 'Coming soon' placeholders instead of names/roles/quotes, the newsletter band's illustration motif is undersized relative to the reference, the hero panel reads slightly narrow, the wide service card's stat strip lacks separation, and the contact band's tile hairline is faint. None of these break layout identity; all are executable copy/CSS refinements within the one repair batch.
